Game Overview

Stack Panda is a casual title where guide an endearing panda through a mesmerizing pixel world, leaping to stack blocks and create an ever-growing tower. As the blocks quicken, your reflexes are tested, making for an exhilarating combination of strategy and action — perfect for players seeking an addictive, fast-paced platforming challenge.

Getting started in Stack Panda doesn't take long to learn. Guide an endearing panda through a mesmerizing pixel world, leaping to stack blocks and create an ever-growing tower.
